in_marathi.name: Ranbir
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the battle
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ranbir हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ranbir is a name derived from the Sanskrit words 'Ran' meaning 'Lord' and 'Bir' meaning 'warrior' or 'battle'. This name is often given to a baby boy in Hindu tradition to signify strength, courage, and leadership.
